Learn moreSign in Comments 30 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description Everything You Need To Know About Australia in Three Minutes 145Likes6,035ViewsJan 212026 We’re going A to Z, one country at a time — and this stop is Australia. A country that’s also a continent, home to some of the deadliest animals on Earth, massive empty space, beaches that never end, and cities where almost everyone actually lives along the coast. How can a place be this huge but feel so empty? Why does almost the entire population hug the ocean? And how did Australia end up with wildlife that looks like it was designed to kill you? Fast facts, geography that breaks your brain, and trivia that sounds fake but is real — perfect for arguments, comments, and “wait WHAT?” moments.
